email.body1:
Cindy, saw PrimePay completed the CoAdvantage merger, bringing PEO services and payroll software under one roof.

Post-merger, there are usually far more cross-sell accounts in play than the sales team can cover before quota resets. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PrimePay off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cindy, quick follow-up for PrimePay.

After a merger, the pipeline target usually jumps faster than the team can ramp coverage. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the combined number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PrimePay needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Cindy, last bit of proof for PrimePay.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PrimePay's reply rate likely compares to similar payroll and HR software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Cindy, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing right after a merger is its own kind of busy, and integration usually eats the calendar.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to PrimePay either way.
